items.name: Drive
items.tip: Drive: how hard the selected distortion type is pushed. Higher = more saturation and harmonics. Extended range goes to 300 %.

items.name: Mech
items.tip: Mech: harder, digital-style crunch (folds and clips the wave). 0 = off. Extended range goes to 200 %.

items.name: Distortion type. Fuzz
items.tip: Distortion type. Fuzz: thick and woolly. RAT: gritty pedal-style hard clip. Overdrive: smooth mid-forward. Rectifier: bright octave-ish edge. Tube: warm even harmonics. Soft Sat: smooth, great on buses. Transistor: console-style, punchy. Tape: gentle and rounded. Diode: edgy and asymmetric. Hard Clip: tight and aggressive.

items.name: Cutoff
items.tip: Cutoff: frequency of the 24 dB low-pass filter. Rolls off the harsh highs distortion creates.

items.name: Res
items.tip: Resonance: boosts the frequencies right at the cutoff.

items.name: Filter type
items.tip: Filter type: Low-pass keeps the lows and cuts the highs, High-pass keeps the highs and cuts the lows, Band-pass keeps only a band around the cutoff.

items.name: Amount
items.tip: Compressor amount: lowers the threshold and raises the ratio together, with make-up gain.

items.name: Phat mode
items.tip: Phat mode: adds low-end weight before the compressor, a slower release and a soft ceiling. Great on kicks and bass.

top.name: Preset menu
top.tip: Factory presets (our own) and your saved presets.

top.name: Randomize
top.tip: Set the knobs to random values (output level, mix, cuts and pan are kept).

top.name: Clipper
top.tip: Soft peak clipper right before the safety limiter (always there, no knob): shaves only the tallest peaks so the limiter works less and the whole thing sits louder without harshness. Switch it off to hear the difference.

top.name: Limiter
top.tip: Safety limiter on the output: keeps the level from ever passing 0 dBFS, smooth and transparent. Turn it off for the raw output.

top.name: Info bubbles (i)
top.tip: Info bubbles: hover a control for one second to see what it does. Click to turn them off or on.
